summary: A toggle for an on/off setting with its label, description and error beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from naming the inner input.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and blocks form submission.

size.note: Track and thumb size: default (16px thumb) or sm (12px thumb).

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current state (on). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. Also applied by a disabled <fieldset> ancestor without changing the attribute.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, drawn as the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: The moving circle; aria-hidden, follows the checked state of the input.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). Fires before the next render; FormData already holds the new value.

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track filled with primary; the thumb moves to the end edge (mirrored in rtl).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl. formValue(): value only while checked, else null. formReset(): restore the checked attribute default. formStateRestore(state): restore checked from saved state. validationAnchor(): the inner input (required -> valueMissing). The inner input gets isDisabled, so a disabled fieldset disables it without overwriting the author's disabled attribute; the dimmed host is styled with :host(:disabled). A <label for> click on the host is forwarded to the input. syncFormState() runs in the input handler so a change listener reads the new FormData.

accessibility.targetSize: The default track is 18px tall, below 24px; the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009)

aria: role="switch" with aria-checked from the native checked state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
disabled: native disabled on the input
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission (SB-0009)
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)
state change is announced by the switch role (on / off); no extra live region

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and takes effect at once or on save
The setting needs its consequence explained
The setting must be on before the form can be submitted
useCases.use: required with a label that states what is turned on

useCases.when: A compact switch in a dense settings list

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for one of several options, or for an agreement submitted with a form
antiPatterns.why: A switch is an on/off setting; choices recorded with a form read as checkboxes

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch holds one on/off value

antiPatterns.pattern: A press-and-hold or pressed-look action button
antiPatterns.why: A switch keeps a state and is named by its label, not by a verb

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside

drift.contract: track border and off thumb use color.input (3:1)
drift.realization: shadcn's off track is bg-input, a fill below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern, label row beside the track, form behavior as the Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox switch> or role="switch" on a checkbox input?
openQuestions.answer: role="switch" on <input type="checkbox">: it works in every supported browser, while the switch attribute is not yet universal. Revisit when it is.

openQuestions.question: Is label required, and is there a hide-label prop?
openQuestions.answer: label is required, like Checkbox. No hide-label for now: nothing asked for it (YAGNI); add it with a use case.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and how are they named?
openQuestions.answer: Two: default and sm, the registered size aliases (default = medium, sm = small). Both change only the track and thumb; label and description type do not change. Thumb 16px / 12px from size.icon.default and size.icon.sm; the track is derived from the thumb and switch.inset (height = thumb + 2 x inset, width = 2 x thumb + 2 x inset), so no new semantic token is needed.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No. The attribute is the default that form reset restores (like native defaultChecked); checked is a property, and the attribute is read at start. Same as Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: What does a switch submit, and what does required mean?
openQuestions.answer: value (default "on") only while on; nothing while off. required means the switch must be on (native valueMissing), as for a checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Does error block submission, and does Enter submit?
openQuestions.answer: Yes to both, per SB-0009: error sets a customError validity, and Enter calls form.requestSubmit() because the inner input has no form owner.

openQuestions.question: Is there a label-position prop (label before the track)?
openQuestions.answer: No. The label is after the track in the writing direction (mirrored in rtl). Not requested; add it with a use case.
